def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # История продаж только до seed_time
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()

    cols = [
        'n_items', 'n_orders', 'n_customers', 'sum_price', 'avg_price',
        'sum_freight', 'avg_freight', 'count_review', 'avg_review',
        'avg_delivery_days', 'recent_30', 'recent_60', 'recent_90',
        'lifetime_days', 'days_since_last', 'months_active',
        'sum_payments', 'avg_payment', 'n_payments',
        'recent_30_orders', 'recent_90_sum_price',
        'trend_30_vs_90', 'avg_freight_ratio', 'n_sellers'
    ]

    if items.empty:
        res = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=list(entity_ids), columns=cols)
        return res.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Информация о заказах: берём только то, что известно на seed_time.
    # Доставка известна, только если она уже произошла до seed_time.
    ord_sub = orders[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date']].copy()
    items = items.merge(ord_sub, on='order_id', how='left')
    delivered_mask = items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    items.loc[~delivered_mask, 'order_delivered_customer_date'] = pd.NaT

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time
    rev_agg = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time] \
        .groupby('order_id')['review_score'].mean().reset_index()
    rev_agg.columns = ['order_id', 'review_mean']
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Платежи: только те, что известны на seed_time
    pay_agg = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time] \
        .groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum().reset_index()
    pay_agg.columns = ['order_id', 'payment_total']
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Длительность доставки в днях (только для доставленных заказов)
    items['delivery_days'] = (
        items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['ts']
    ).dt.days

    # Основные агрегаты по товару
    feat = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        n_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        count_review=('review_mean', 'count'),
        avg_review=('review_mean', 'mean'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        sum_payments=('payment_total', 'sum'),
        avg_payment=('payment_total', 'mean'),
        n_payments=('payment_total', 'count'),
        n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique')
    )

    # Окна 30/60/90 дней до seed_time
    for window in (30, 60, 90):
        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (items['ts'] >= start) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
        tmp = items[mask].groupby('product_id').size()
        feat[f'recent_{window}'] = tmp

    start30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    start90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    m30 = (items['ts'] >= start30) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    m90 = (items['ts'] >= start90) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    feat['recent_30_orders'] = items[m30].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    feat['recent_90_sum_price'] = items[m90].groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()

    # Тренд: продажи за последние 30 дней против предыдущих 60
    feat['trend_30_vs_90'] = feat['recent_30'] / (feat['recent_90'] - feat['recent_30'] + 1.0)

    # Доля доставки в цене
    feat['avg_freight_ratio'] = feat['avg_freight'] / (feat['avg_price'] + 1e-9)

    # Первая/последняя дата покупки
    first_last = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].agg(['min', 'max'])
    feat['lifetime_days'] = (first_last['max'] - first_last['min']).dt.days
    feat['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - first_last['max']).dt.days

    # Количество активных месяцев
    items['ym'] = items['ts'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    feat['months_active'] = items.groupby('product_id')['ym'].nunique()

    # Реиндексация по всем запрошенным товарам
    feat = feat.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Заполняем пропуски (товары без истории) нулями
    feat = feat.fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    return feat
